summary: When a colleague leaves, the people who worked with that person exchange fewer messages for a while.
realLife: A study of communication data at a large holding company found a breakdown in contact among remaining coworkers after a colleague left, worse in stressful periods.
sources: MIT DSpace, Exit Ripple Effects: Understanding the Disruption of Socialization Networks Following Employee Departures: https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/155157
inGame: coworker ties and their closeness after a job-ended event for one person.

turns.summary: The team hosts a lunch and keeps the ties.
The group splits into those who stay in touch and those who do not.
A new coworker takes the leaver's seat and ties re-form around that person.
